summary: Pure logic, zero guesswork: thousands of relaxing Einstein Riddles
description:
Master Einstein's Riddles: Pure deduction game. No guesses. 🧠
Played and loved by millions since 2013.
5,000+ FREE puzzles. Compete live. Crush leaderboards.
Clues like: "German owns a dog. The one who drinks coffee does not have a fox"
✅ Endless Free Content: 5K+ single player logic puzzles – zero paywalls
✅ Daily Fresh: 15 new Zebra Puzzles every day
✅ Live Competition 🔥: Compete real-time worldwide – same puzzle, fastest wins. Rank in leaderboards.
✅ 49 Achievements: from your first solve to 5,000 puzzles, daily-challenge streaks and hours at the grid
✅ Scale Up: Easy 4x4 to massive grids
✅ Tutorial + Tools: Guided first solve + a clue filter that hides what you have already ruled out
✅ Color Themes: Light, Dark and a range of colors – pick the one that suits the room you are in
✅ New Modern Layout, optional: keeps the full clue list and the filter inside the match, so everything sits on one screen
✅ Portrait or Landscape: Turn the phone sideways and the whole board follows
✅ Built for Thumbs: Tap to cross out, hold to confirm – the grid does the bookkeeping
🆕 NEW – TWO SHORTCUTS WORTH LEARNING
🔹 Drag the element to the clue panel to view clues of that element
🔹 Click the element in the clue panel to go to the next clue of that element
Deduce the full grid. Logic lovers: this is your next obsession.
